label: B2 from the selected-grounding closure and the ground-to-esse-cause bridge
meaning: A being x contingent at w is concrete (interface), exists at w and is contingent, so the existing closure gives it an actual concrete ground y at w under the selected relation. The existing bridge 'an actual concrete ground of an actual concretum is a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse' makes y distinct from x and a cause of its esse. So x has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse: B2, on the profile built from the same frame.
